svg.desc: An ML platform. Event streams, databases and batch tables feed a feature platform, then a training platform, a registry with deployment, and serving for online and batch use. A metadata, lineage and access-control layer spans the components, and a monitoring platform beneath them watches data quality, drift, delayed-label performance and cost, and can trigger retraining.
